claim_verbatim: They’ll never get one -there was a lot of impure dodgy gold put in there in the 1930s . It probably needs to be recalled and re refined but I wouldn’t hold my breath.
context: Reply to @acullen03, who asked where the gold for a gold-backed Treasury bond would come from and said 'The U.S. taxpayer still does not have an audit of the gold they claim to hold'. Thread under Craig's 11 Nov post on Judy Shelton's 'buckle up' remark.
probability_words: never (not on the word map; nearest is won't)
resolution_criterion: Claim: US taxpayers will never get an audit of the gold the US government claims to hold. 'Never' has no deadline, so it cannot resolve true; unscorable. It would resolve false if a full independent physical audit (assay) of US Treasury-owned gold reserves is completed and published. Related to pl-126 (gold certificates change only via 31 USC 5117(b) amendment).
